aaii.name: American Association of Individual Investors
aaii.notes: AAII Sentiment Survey distributed via subscription/dashboard; redistribution requires review per docs/source_reviews/aaii_naaim.md.

bea.name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
bea.notes: Free public macroeconomic data hosted by BEA and mirrored on FRED.

bls.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
bls.notes: Free public labor and inflation data hosted by BLS.

cboe.name: Cboe Global Markets
cboe.notes: Cboe historical index CSV files are public and delayed; source caveats should be shown with the data.

cboe_futures.name: Cboe Futures Exchange
cboe_futures.notes: VIX futures curve data requires access and redistribution review before automated publication.

cboe_options.name: Cboe Options Market Statistics
cboe_options.notes: Put-call data requires access, automation, attribution, and redistribution review before automated publication.

cftc.name: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission
cftc.notes: Public historical compressed Commitments of Traders reports.

derived.name: Derived
derived.notes: Computed from active public inputs in this repository.

economic_calendar.name: Economic Release Calendar
economic_calendar.notes: Economic calendar sources require access, attribution, automation, and redistribution review before automated publication.

fiscaldata.name: U.S. Treasury FiscalData
fiscaldata.notes: Official Treasury FiscalData API paths can be generated into static candidate diagnostics with dataset attribution.

fred.name: Federal Reserve Economic Data
fred.notes: FRED graph CSV endpoints do not require secrets; hosted series can carry source-specific citation or redistribution requirements.

ice_indices.name: ICE Data Indices
ice_indices.notes: MOVE Index access and static redistribution require source review before active ingestion.

multpl_shiller.name: Robert Shiller / multpl.com
multpl_shiller.notes: Shiller CAPE distributed under a public-data convention; multpl.com mirrors. Confirm endpoint stability in source review.

naaim.name: National Association of Active Investment Managers
naaim.notes: NAAIM Exposure Index publishes a weekly XLS; redistribution and commercial-use terms require review per docs/source_reviews/aaii_naaim.md.

ny_fed.name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
ny_fed.notes: Public Federal Reserve research data; candidate pending endpoint/terms confirmation.

occ.name: Options Clearing Corporation
occ.notes: Options statistics require source-specific access, citation, and redistribution review before automated publication.

terms_review.name: Terms-reviewed candidate sources
terms_review.notes: Useful sources that require access, terms, licensing, citation, or redistribution review before automated publication.

tradingview.name: TradingView (authenticated candidate)
tradingview.notes: Authenticated candidate feed. Used only as candidate-only fallback for MOVE / put-call / VX. Never enters active scoring. Secrets injected via GitHub Actions environment.

treasury_calendar.name: Treasury Auction Calendar
treasury_calendar.notes: Treasury auction schedules require source-specific access, attribution, and redistribution review before automated publication.

unavailable.name: Unavailable or restricted sources
unavailable.notes: Sources that are not freely automatable for this static no-secret project.
